compiler.integration: Separate example workspace. Existing Policy Studio compiler pin, generator and admission gate remain unchanged.

upstream.extension: Unknown Text authority labels return false. This does not preserve out-of-domain TypeScript exceptions.

conditions.provider_ok: provider_verified is true; the host must establish this fact before projecting it
conditions.evidence_ok: confidence is exactly observed and status is exactly pass
conditions.binding_ok: Both binding strings are canonical sha256 text and exactly equal
conditions.artifact_ok: Both artifact strings are canonical sha256 text and exactly equal
conditions.policy_ok: Both policy strings are canonical sha256 text and exactly equal
conditions.freshness_ok: observed_at_unix, now_unix and max_age_seconds are nonnegative; observed_at_unix is not in the future; only after those guards, now_unix minus observed_at_unix is at most max_age_seconds
conditions.deadline_ok: now_unix and expires_at_unix are nonnegative and now_unix is strictly less than expires_at_unix
conditions.admissible: All eight condition fields are true; every condition remains visible even when an earlier one fails

canonical_digest.format: sha256: followed by exactly 64 ASCII lowercase hexadecimal bytes

host_owned_preconditions: Authenticate the machine principal and recognize the trusted observation provider through a real host-controlled observation or independently validated provider credential path. Client-authored provider_verified=true is never such proof.

Strictly validate the observation envelope, result types, content hashes, source/artifact/producer identities and full required verification corpus. A self-consistent unsigned hash alone cannot establish provider identity or truth.

Recompute observed_binding and required_binding from a documented unambiguous encoding of principal, request ID, operation, request revision and complete required verification corpus. No canonicalization or hashing implementation is supplied by this pure example.

Own the current artifact identity, complete policy identity including policy values, requirement authority, expiry and maximum age. Obtain now_unix from the host clock. The caller must not choose these requirements or the clock.

Project all fifteen scalar fields from those verified observations and requirements. This workspace accepts synthetic fixture inputs for demonstration and is not itself a trusted provider integration.

After an admissible evidence decision, still enforce current authentication, execution permissions, request revision and policy version under the real gate's serialization boundary. Persist the bounded effect and idempotency outcome atomically.
A saved execution receipt or historical replay grants no fresh authority. Existing committed retries retain their original outcome and must not blindly perform a second effect.
automation_example: Before an API automation policy update, a host-owned runner binds protocol or packaged-process observations to the exact candidate artifact, full regression corpus, policy version, request revision and machine principal. Gooo checks compatibility, binding and time validity without a per-call human approval condition. This prototype does not implement that runner or update any actual policy.

case_files.expected_observation: Every case supplies all ten independent expected output fields, including failed-condition observations and first-reason precedence.
case_files.actual_execution_status: Inspect CI artifact observations.json for an actual run; the contract itself is not execution evidence.

not_claimed: Actual evidence authenticity or signature verification
Execution permission or an external effect
Integration with the existing authenticated machine gate
Canonical JSON hashing or full REA ledger/provider/MCP translation
Any customer trial, adoption or revenue
